name: http_client
description: Make HTTP GET and POST requests directly from DuckDB SQL. Returns a JSON object with `status`, `reason`, and `body` you can extract inline. Best fit: ad-hoc API calls, low-volume per-row enrichment, and joining a SQL query with a small REST endpoint. Synchronous and buffered — not a streaming or high-throughput HTTP client.

cta.title: HTTP calls from a SELECT
cta.description: Install HTTP Client to issue GET / POST requests inside DuckDB queries — handy for joining a database column against a REST API.
